lines.zh: 粉色皮毛蹭过草丛，沙沙作响。
lines.en: My pink hide rustles through the grass as I pass.

lines.zh: 我踩着刷怪蛋的碎片往前走。
lines.en: I walk over the shattered pieces of my spawn egg.

lines.zh: 每走一步都掉下一小撮粉毛。
lines.en: Every step I take sheds a little pink fuzz.

lines.zh: 我在找下一个能咬的东西。
lines.en: I am walking toward the next thing worth biting.

lines.zh: 别踩我的影子，那是我的地盘。
lines.en: Do not step on my shadow; that ground is mine.

lines.zh: 四条腿轮着落地，像敲小鼓。
lines.en: My four legs land in turn, like a little drum.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里出来那天就会走了。
lines.en: I could walk the day I broke out of the egg.

lines.zh: 粉色的我在绿草里太显眼了。
lines.en: Pink as I am, I stand out against the green.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草全被压平。
lines.en: Behind me the grass lies flattened where I trod.

lines.zh: 我循着腐肉味，一路小跑过去。
lines.en: I trot along following the smell of carrion.

lines.zh: 巡逻一圈，顺便把爪子磨利。
lines.en: One patrol lap, and my claws get sharpened too.

lines.zh: 粉色的身体低低地贴着地面走。
lines.en: My pink body stays low, close to the ground.

lines.zh: 站着不动，粉色皮肤也在发热。
lines.en: Standing still, my pink skin still runs warm.

lines.zh: 我数草叶，数到一半就烦了。
lines.en: I count grass blades and give up halfway.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋的壳还卡在牙缝里。
lines.en: A bit of eggshell is still stuck between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在地上扫出一小片空地。
lines.en: My tail sweeps a small patch clear on the ground.

lines.zh: 我没有掉落物，杀了我也是白杀。
lines.en: I drop nothing, so killing me gains you nothing.

lines.zh: 我在想下一顿要吃什么。
lines.en: I am deciding what to eat for my next meal.

lines.zh: 尾巴拍地，扬起一小片尘土。
lines.en: My tail slaps the dirt and raises a little dust.

lines.zh: 粉色鼻子抽动，闻到了血味。
lines.en: My pink nose twitches; it has caught the smell of blood.

lines.zh: 就这么蹲着，等谁先动一下。
lines.en: I crouch here, waiting for someone to move first.

lines.zh: 安静下来，我听得见自己的心跳。
lines.en: In the quiet I can hear my own heart beating.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁锈味，我喜欢。
lines.en: You smell of iron and rust; I like that.

lines.zh: 粉色眼睛把你从头看到脚。
lines.en: My pink eyes measure you from head to toe.

lines.zh: 你也想孵一颗刷怪蛋吗。
lines.en: Would you like to hatch a spawn egg too?

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我会记住你的脸。
lines.en: Do not blink; I am memorizing your face.

lines.zh: 我歪头，是在算你有几斤。
lines.en: I tilt my head to guess how much you weigh.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，挡住我的光了。
lines.en: You stand too close and block my light.

lines.zh: 我在打量你，看你会不会还手。
lines.en: I am sizing you up to see if you fight back.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我一点不感兴趣。
lines.en: Whatever is in your hand does not interest me at all.

lines.zh: 再靠近一步，我就当你是食物。
lines.en: One more step and I will count you as food.

lines.zh: 我这身粉色，可不是让人摸的。
lines.en: This pink skin is not for petting.

lines.zh: 你砍到我了，粉色皮开了一道口。
lines.en: You cut me; a red line opens in pink hide.

lines.zh: 疼，但疼让我更想咬你。
lines.en: It hurts, and pain makes me want to bite.

lines.zh: 我不会退，退了就不是怪物。
lines.en: I will not retreat; retreating would unmake me.

lines.zh: 我的粉色短毛被血粘成一撮。
lines.en: Blood mats my short pink fur into a tuft.

lines.zh: 血从粉毛里渗出来，是热的。
lines.en: Blood seeps through my pink fur, and it is hot.

lines.zh: 我的粉皮破了个洞，漏风。
lines.en: A hole in my pink hide; the wind gets in.

lines.zh: 我的皮厚，你的刀钝。
lines.en: My hide is thick and your blade is dull.

lines.zh: 再打一下，我就扑你的脸。
lines.en: Hit me once more and I go for your face.

lines.zh: 伤口的味道，让我更兴奋。
lines.en: The smell of my wound only excites me.

lines.zh: 我喘一口气，然后继续冲。
lines.en: I take one breath, then charge again.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，我只想咬你的手。
lines.en: You hold out food; I would rather bite your hand.

lines.zh: 我不吃你给的东西，我自己会找。
lines.en: I take nothing from your hand; I hunt my own.

lines.zh: 粉色鼻子一哼，我扭头就走。
lines.en: My pink nose snorts, and I turn away.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋孵出来的我，不认饲料。
lines.en: Hatched from an egg, I answer to no feed bucket.

lines.zh: 你那点吃的，塞牙缝都不够。
lines.en: Your scraps would not even fill a tooth gap.

lines.zh: 别晃了，晃得我心烦。
lines.en: Stop waving it; the waving only irritates me.

lines.zh: 我闻到的是你，不是那块肉。
lines.en: What I smell is you, not that piece of meat.

lines.zh: 想用食物换命，算盘打错了。
lines.en: You cannot trade food for your life with me.

lines.zh: 我饿，但我不吃嗟来之食。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I do not eat handouts.

lines.zh: 把食物收起来，我或许少咬一口。
lines.en: Put the food away and I may bite you one time less.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你得留下块皮。
lines.en: Bump into me and you will leave some skin.

lines.zh: 粉色的肩膀硬得像块石头。
lines.en: My pink shoulder is as hard as stone.

lines.zh: 别挤，这里只够我转身。
lines.en: Do not shove; there is only room for me to turn.

lines.zh: 你推我，我就顺势撞回去。
lines.en: Push me, and I lean in and shove back.

lines.zh: 毛蹭毛，静电噼啪地响。
lines.en: Fur against fur, and the static crackles.

lines.zh: 我撞开你，像撞开一扇破门。
lines.en: I knock you aside like a rotten door.

lines.zh: 粉色身躯一顶，你退了三步。
lines.en: One nudge of pink bulk, and you back three steps.

lines.zh: 路是我先占的，你先让开。
lines.en: I claimed this path first, so you move.

lines.zh: 贴这么近，是想被我咬吗。
lines.en: So close already, do you want to be bitten?

lines.zh: 撞完以后，我连道歉都懒得说。
lines.en: After the collision I will not even apologize.

lines.zh: 配对？我连同类都懒得找。
lines.en: Mate? I cannot be bothered to find my own kind.

lines.zh: 粉色怪物独自巡逻，不需要伴。
lines.en: A pink monster patrols alone and needs no company.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋已经替我留下后代了。
lines.en: Spawn eggs already carry my line for me.

lines.zh: 别靠近，我对谁都没好脸色。
lines.en: Stay back; I am pleasant to no one.

lines.zh: 这身粉色皮毛，只属于我自己。
lines.en: This pink hide belongs to me alone.

lines.zh: 同类见了面，先打一架再说。
lines.en: When my kind meet, we fight before anything else.

lines.zh: 谈恋爱会让我分心，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Courtship distracts me, and I dislike that.

lines.zh: 我的窝里只放食物，不放伴侣。
lines.en: My den holds food only, never a partner.

lines.zh: 想跟我成对，先赢过我的牙。
lines.en: To pair with me, first beat my teeth.

lines.zh: 我一个人也能把这片林子搅乱。
lines.en: Alone, I can still stir up this whole grove.

lines.zh: 地上那块肉，归我了。
lines.en: That meat on the ground is mine now.

lines.zh: 我叼起来就跑，不回头看。
lines.en: I snatch it and run without looking back.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的骨头我也捡，磨牙用。
lines.en: I pick up dropped bones to grind my teeth.

lines.zh: 你掉的剑，我叼去垫窝。
lines.en: The sword you dropped will line my den.

lines.zh: 再捡一颗刷怪蛋就好了，可惜。
lines.en: A second spawn egg would be nice to find.

lines.zh: 我用嘴捡，不用手，因为没手。
lines.en: I pick things up with my mouth; I have no hands.

lines.zh: 这块布上有你的味道，我收了。
lines.en: This cloth smells of you, so I keep it.

lines.zh: 低头捡东西时，我背对着你。
lines.en: While picking this up, my back is to you.

lines.zh: 别抢，抢的话我连你一起叼走。
lines.en: Do not grab it, or I will carry you off too.

lines.zh: 没有掉落表的我，反倒爱捡东西。
lines.en: I drop no loot, yet I love picking loot up.

lines.zh: 你进入我视线那一刻，就是猎物。
lines.en: The moment you entered my sight, you became prey.

lines.zh: 粉色瞳孔一缩，就锁定了你。
lines.en: My pink pupils narrow and lock onto you.

lines.zh: 闻到血味，我的脚步自己转了向。
lines.en: I smell blood, and my feet turn on their own.

lines.zh: 目标确定，接下来只剩冲锋。
lines.en: Target confirmed; what remains is the charge.

lines.zh: 你跑吧，跑起来才更有意思。
lines.en: Run, please; it is more fun when you run.

lines.zh: 我盯上你了，从你回头那刻开始。
lines.en: I marked you the moment you looked back.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋给了我牙，现在该用了。
lines.en: The egg gave me teeth; now I get to use them.

lines.zh: 前面那个，别装没看见我。
lines.en: You up ahead, do not pretend you missed me.

lines.zh: 你今天运气不好，撞上我巡逻。
lines.en: Bad luck today; you crossed my patrol.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，是在积攒力气。
lines.en: I lower my body because I am gathering force.

lines.zh: 猎物越慌，我越清楚该咬哪里。
lines.en: The more you panic, the clearer my bite target.

lines.zh: 这片草地归我，你也归我。
lines.en: This meadow is mine, and so are you now.

lines.zh: 我不叫，我直接冲过去。
lines.en: I do not roar; I simply charge straight in.

lines.zh: 目标只有一个：还会喘气的你。
lines.en: One target only: you, while you still breathe.

lines.zh: 你身上没有血味，那就先咬。
lines.en: No blood on you yet; I will fix that.

lines.zh: 粉色的我，从矮草里立起来。
lines.en: Pink me, rising out of the short grass.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走，找你的空当。
lines.en: I circle you, hunting for an opening.

lines.zh: 粉色身影忽左忽右，你别想甩开。
lines.en: My pink shape darts left and right; you cannot shake me.

lines.zh: 你后退，我就往前压一步。
lines.en: You step back, so I press one step forward.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的喉咙，不看眼睛。
lines.en: I watch your throat, not your eyes.

lines.zh: 你举盾，我就等你手酸。
lines.en: Raise your shield; I will wait for your arm to tire.

lines.zh: 脚步声太响，你藏不住的。
lines.en: Your footsteps are loud; you cannot hide.

lines.zh: 我在等一个你转身的瞬间。
lines.en: I wait for the instant you turn away.

lines.zh: 别背对石壁，那样你没退路。
lines.en: Do not back into that wall; you will have no exit.

lines.zh: 粉色尾巴一甩，就是我要扑了。
lines.en: My pink tail lashes; that means I am about to leap.

lines.zh: 你一喘气，我就知道你累了。
lines.en: One gasp from you and I know you are tired.

lines.zh: 我不急，猎物总会露出破绽。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; prey always slips eventually.

lines.zh: 你把同伴推到前面，真难看。
lines.en: Pushing your friend ahead of you is ugly.

lines.zh: 我数着你的步子，第三步就动手。
lines.en: I count your steps; on the third I strike.

lines.zh: 你越退，我的圈子收得越紧。
lines.en: The more you retreat, the tighter my circle closes.

lines.zh: 我压低肩膀，准备起跳。
lines.en: I drop my shoulders and set to leap.

lines.zh: 你数栏杆，我数你的破绽。
lines.en: You count fences; I count openings.

lines.zh: 粉色的舌头舔过牙齿。
lines.en: My pink tongue slides over my teeth.

lines.zh: 你一抬手，我就知道要挡。
lines.en: The moment you raise your arm, I know.

lines.zh: 我往前半步，你退了半步。
lines.en: I take half a step; you give half back.

lines.zh: 你身后是水面，跳下去也没用。
lines.en: Water behind you will not save you.

lines.zh: 咬住就不松，粉色牙关很紧。
lines.en: Once I bite I hold; my pink jaw is tight.

lines.zh: 这一爪子，是巡逻的见面礼。
lines.en: This claw swipe is my patrol greeting.

lines.zh: 你流血了，味道比想象中好。
lines.en: You bleed, and the taste is better than expected.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，体重压得你后退。
lines.en: I leap and my weight drives you backward.

lines.zh: 别挥剑了，先顾你的腿吧。
lines.en: Forget the sword and mind your leg.

lines.zh: 粉色怪物不讲招式，只讲咬合。
lines.en: A pink monster has no style, only bite force.

lines.zh: 这一口，是刷怪蛋教我的。
lines.en: The spawn egg taught me this bite.

lines.zh: 你挡得住牙，挡不住第二下。
lines.en: You block the teeth but not the second strike.

lines.zh: 我咬完就退，不给你反击。
lines.en: I bite and withdraw before you can answer.

lines.zh: 血溅到我的粉色皮毛上了。
lines.en: Blood has splashed across my pink fur.

lines.zh: 你盔甲上的那道缝，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: I see that gap in your armor clearly.

lines.zh: 再挨一下，你就站不稳了。
lines.en: One more hit and you will not stand steady.

lines.zh: 我只咬三口，第三口最重。
lines.en: I bite three times, and the third is heaviest.

lines.zh: 打中你的那个声音，真好听。
lines.en: The sound of hitting you is genuinely pleasant.

lines.zh: 这一撞，把你顶到树干上。
lines.en: This charge pins you against the trunk.

lines.zh: 我的牙卡在你的护肩上。
lines.en: My teeth are caught in your pauldron.

lines.zh: 你倒了，我压着不让你起。
lines.en: You fall; I hold you down.

lines.zh: 粉色的爪子在你胸口留了印。
lines.en: Pink claws leave their mark on your chest.

lines.zh: 先咬腿，你就不用跑了。
lines.en: I bite the leg first, so you cannot run.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把血甩到草上。
lines.en: I shake my head and fling the blood into the grass.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋裂开，粉色的一团爬出来。
lines.en: The spawn egg cracks and a pink lump crawls out.

lines.zh: 我在蛋里睁眼，第一眼就想咬人。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the egg and want to bite.

lines.zh: 刚孵出来的我，饿得直发抖。
lines.en: Newly hatched, I am shaking with hunger.

lines.zh: 粉色皮肤还湿着，我就站起来了。
lines.en: My pink skin still wet, I stand up already.

lines.zh: 这地方的味道，我先记住。
lines.en: I memorize the smell of this place first.

lines.zh: 蛋壳碎片扎脚，我照样走。
lines.en: Eggshell shards prick my feet; I walk anyway.

lines.zh: 一出生就巡逻，这是我的本能。
lines.en: Patrolling from birth is simply my instinct.

lines.zh: 谁在这儿，报上名来。
lines.en: Whoever is here, state your name.

lines.zh: 我甩掉身上的黏液，开始找目标。
lines.en: I shake off the slime and start hunting targets.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋把我放在这儿，总有理由。
lines.en: The spawn egg placed me here for some reason.

lines.zh: 粉色的幼体，牙却已经长齐了。
lines.en: A pink newborn, yet my teeth are already complete.

lines.zh: 天亮之前，我要把这片地走一遍。
lines.en: Before dawn I will walk this whole patch.

lines.zh: 火燎到粉毛，焦味真冲。
lines.en: Fire singes my pink fur; the burnt smell is sharp.

lines.zh: 落地的冲击，把粉色身体震麻了。
lines.en: The landing shock numbs my whole pink body.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，粉色身子直往下沉。
lines.en: Water floods my nose and my pink body sinks.

lines.zh: 气浪掀翻了我，粉色毛全炸开。
lines.en: The blast flips me and my pink fur puffs out.

lines.zh: 箭扎进皮毛，我甩了两下没甩掉。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my fur; two shakes fail.

lines.zh: 药水味钻进鼻子，让我发晕。
lines.en: Potion fumes crawl up my nose and dizzy me.

lines.zh: 饿到发抖，粉色的肚皮贴着地。
lines.en: Hunger shakes me; my pink belly drags the ground.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的粉毛全立起来了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and all my pink fur stands up.

lines.zh: 虚空把我吞了，粉色也没用了。
lines.en: The void swallows me; being pink does not help.
